description: requirements.txt that includes requirements/base.txt, plus requirements/dev.txt with a -r include and a -c constraints file (#44). Includes resolve relative to the including file; constraint pins are not declarations. gunicorn is never imported (it runs as a server), so M2 reports only the low-confidence manual-review note, never unused.
